Comment `@pr-lens draw` on a pull request when you want that one drawn - Add `.github/workflows/pr-lens.yml` with `coldteadotai/pr-lens/packages/action@v0` and your model provider's key as its `api-key` to run PR Lens from your own CI. Any `/chat/completions` endpoint works - After a push, tick **Redraw** to draw the latest commit - Switch GitHub to dark mode and the diagrams follow. The moving dots are this pull request's data in motion

performed_via_github_app.name: Coldtea PR Lens
performed_via_github_app.description:
PR Lens draws every pull request as an animated architecture and data flow diagram, posted as a comment on the PR itself.
 
- See the blast radius. Which components a change touches: new in green, changed in amber, removed in red
- Watch the data flow. Animated arrows trace the request path your change created, step by step.
- Stay in GitHub. Toggle detail levels with checkboxes in the comment. No dashboard, no tab-switching.
- Not Mermaid. A bespoke renderer built to reduce cognitive overload.
- Zero setup. Install, open a PR, and the diagram appears in under a minute or two. Free for open source.
 
Built for reducing the cognitive load on reviewing AI-generated PRs.  by the team behind [Coldtea](https://coldtea.ai)
